record.notes: Made under article 33 of the Data Protection Act and published in Government Gazette No. 21,519 of 10 October 2025, together with Legal Notice 226 of 2025 (the Artificial Intelligence Regulations, 2025), under which the MDIA is the default market surveillance authority, single point of contact and notifying authority. Regulation 1(3) deferred regulations 5 to 7 and 9 to 12 (fundamental-rights authority, real-time and post-remote biometric identification, documentation, language requirements, registry, complaints) to 2 August 2026; the designations, the notified-body role and the penalty provisions are not deferred. The Commissioner acts as notified body for high-risk systems put into service by law-enforcement, immigration or asylum authorities and keeps a registry of the high-risk systems it supervises. Post-remote biometric identification needs a Magistrate's authorisation, requested ex ante or within 48 hours. Penalties on a public authority or body are capped at EUR 50,000 per infringement plus EUR 50 a day; appeals lie to the Information and Data Protection Appeals Tribunal, and proceedings are time-barred after two years.

verification.note: Stored and read in this run: the English text of the legal notice as published (legislation.mt PDF, 10 pages), which gives the title, the enabling power, the commencement rule in regulation 1(3) and regulations 2 to 13 but does not print the Gazette header; the Maltese text (legislation.mt PDF, 10 pages), whose first page carries the header 'Suppliment tal-Gazzetta tal-Gvern ta’ Malta Nru. 21,519, 10 ta’ Ottubru, 2025' and the same commencement rule; and the legislation.mt ELI page, stored again on 17 October 2026 (its legal content is unchanged; only the site's list of latest updates differs), which gives the Gazette number and date. The ELI page's metadata (in the stored HTML, not in its text) gives 10 October 2025 as first date of entry into force.

judgment.status_reasoning: Published in Government Gazette Supplement No. 21,519 of 10 October 2025 (header of the Maltese text). Regulation 1(3) defers only regulations 5 to 7 and 9 to 12, to 2 August 2026; the designations (regulations 3 and 4), the notified-body role (8) and the penalties (13) carry no deferred date and took effect on publication (the ELI page's metadata gives 10 October 2025 as first date of entry into force). 2 August 2026 has passed (today 17 October 2026), so the whole instrument is in force.
